responsibility: GNU Objective-C runtime backend for ABI version 8. It fills the objc_runtime_hooks table with GNU-runtime implementations for class/category/protocol/string metadata declarations, selector/class/protocol references, ivar and super handling, method-call lowering through objc_msg_lookup/objc_msg_lookup_super, constant-string setup, and final emission of GNU runtime metadata such as selector tables, protocol records, symtab/module descriptors, and initializer routines; it also provides the GNU-runtime exception hooks, including Objective-C catch-type mapping and the gnu_objc personality/throw-catch tree construction.
